fault: anything that keeps the object from recording a deposit whose ledger entry was written: the object reset right after the statement (crash_after on the insert), or the statement's answer lost (ambiguous); the caller's resend finds no record in the object and writes the entry again
description: An account object writes a deposit's entry to a shared ledger database through its own env, then records the deposit in its own storage, which is what makes a resent deposit count once. An entry written and not recorded is written a second time when the caller resends the deposit.
